description: API endpoint directory for IDOR Eats application. Directory listing is enabled, exposing all API endpoints. Contains authentication, user data management, and restaurant search endpoints.

endpoints: change_password.php - POST - Change user password (requires authentication, IDOR vulnerability)
get_favorite_restaurants.php - GET - Retrieve favorite restaurants for user (requires authentication, IDOR vulnerability with userId parameter)
search_restaurants.php - GET - Search restaurants by query parameter

notes: Directory listing enabled exposes all API files, making it easy to discover endpoints. IDOR vulnerabilities present in get_favorite_restaurants.php and change_password.php endpoints through userId parameter manipulation. The search_restaurants.php is publicly accessible without authentication.
